title: Elodie and the Machine
author: Sable Montrose
blurb: Tamsin Almeida, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
